services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Ah, anchoring- boating's unsung hero. Anchoring is the quiet MVP of any day on the water, whether you’re chasing a big ole’ fluke, taking a break to enjoy the water, or sipping a cold drink while admiring the horizon. There’s an art to this essential skill. Mastering the art of anchoring can mean the difference between a peaceful float and a chaotic drift. Here’s a deep dive into anchoring essentials so you can make your next outing smooth, safe, and HOT TO GO! services.name: Drift fishing
services.desc: Step aboard our rugged and spacious 25' panga boat, purpose-built for shallow bay missions, inshore fishing, and long coastal runs. Based in Greenport and Sag Harbor, we offer personalized guided fishing charters across Long Island’s North and South Fork, targeting the top Northeast sportfish on fly and light tackle. Join Captain Arek, a seasoned local guide with lifelong experience fishing the waters of Long Island Sound, Peconic Bay, and Montauk, for an exciting day on the water. Whether you're chasing striped bass, bluefish, false albacore, or bonito, we tailor each trip to your style and experience level. blurb: Guests can rent boats, sailboats, and kayaks to explore the south shore waters, find fishing spots, sail, or anchor at sandy islands for a day of fun. The experience includes eco-tourism with up-close marine life viewing and educational opportunities. After boating, guests can enjoy fresh coastal fare at Lily’s Seaside waterfront dining.
